entry.title: F1 Vs MotoGP Vs Rally Vs Truck Vs Snowmobile: Ultimate Winter Race 🧊

media:group.media:title: F1 Vs MotoGP Vs Rally Vs Truck Vs Snowmobile: Ultimate Winter Race 🧊
media:group.media:description:
Which of the fastest vehicles in the world would win a race on ice? We built the ultimate winter motorsports playground on a frozen lake to find out. For a fair head to head battle we combined snow and ice to create circuits optimised for the strengths of each vehicle, and fitted them with special studded tyres and modifications for the extreme cold. But which will come out on top and slide to victory? ❄️
Gunnar Sterne rides the Snowmobile Ski-Doo 440 Race Sled @andrewcarlson15 rips his off-road PRO4 Truck 🛻 Scott Speed lives up to his name in the Subaru WRX ARA 25 💨 Patrick Friesacher takes the wheel of the @redbullracing World Championship RB7 Formula 1 Car 🏁 Dani Pedrosa rides the KTM RC16 MotoGP Bike
Dive into the action, hosted by Jeremiah Burton of @bigtimebigtimebigtime
